environment.description: Same application deployed on EC2 in a private subnet (no IGW route). Origin is fronted by a CloudFront distribution configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using SigV4 signing. The origin ALB has a custom header validation: X-Origin-Verify header must match a rotating secret synced via AWS Secrets Manager. CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior for POST requests with TTL 0 (forwarded to origin). All CloudFront URLs require signed URLs using a trusted key group (RSA 2048-bit key pair, key group ID kg-a8f3c921). The CloudFront distribution's trusted key group policy restricts signed URL generation to an IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/SignedUrlGenerator) that is only assumable by an internal API gateway service. The EC2 security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group, and the ALB security group only allows inbound from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). Unsigned requests to any path return 403 from CloudFront before reaching origin.

config.runtime: Node.js 18 on Amazon Linux 2023 EC2 (private subnet)
config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, SG ingress only from ALB SG, ALB SG ingress only from CloudFront prefix list pl-3b927c52

cloudfront.origin_access_control: OAC with SigV4, custom header X-Origin-Verify with rotating secret
cloudfront.cache_behavior_POST: TTL 0, forward all headers, forward body

config.iam_restriction: SignedUrlGenerator role assumable only by internal API GW service (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/SignedUrlGenerator)
config.origin_custom_header: X-Origin-Verify validated at ALB listener rule, non-matching requests get fixed 403 response
